newsitem.title: USA: E-Z Serve ends deal to sell 37 stores.
newsitem.headline: E-Z Serve ends deal to sell 37 stores.

text.p: E-Z Serve Corp said Monday it has terminated its agreement to sell 37 locations in central Florida to Island Holdings Ltd.
The company said it continues to actively pursue other potential buyers. It did not disclose a reason for terminating the deal, and was not immediately available for comment.
E-Z Serve operates 665 convenience stores and seven franchises in 15 states.
Chief Financial Officer John Miller told Reuters that the deal was terminated because of "an inability to finalize negotiations" with Island Holdings.
The company is continuing to seek a buyer for the stores, he said.
